Extracts images from img, picture, og:image, twitter:image

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(None)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.status_code)
    print(len(result.images))
    print(result.metadata.og_image)

asyncio.run(main())
```
